DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 集会所についてのご相談と伺いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: I understand you would like to ask about a meeting hall.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 電話で「公民館」とだけ言ったら、家から遠い施設の話になりました。近所の小さな集会所を借りたいんです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 公民館とだけ呼び別施設の案内になったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I just said ‘community center’ on the phone, they started talking about a facility far from my home. I want to rent the small meeting hall in my neighborhood.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that calling it just a community center led to guidance about a different facility. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 施設の名称や場所が分かるものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have anything showing the facility's name or location?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口の看板をメモしました。地区名が付いています。大きな公民館と同じ施設だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 地区名付き看板を示し同施設だと思っていたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I wrote down the sign at the entrance. It includes the district name. I thought it was the same facility as the large community center.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the sign with the district name and say you thought it was the same facility. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 管理者や利用申込み先が同じとは限りません。名称をもとに担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: They do not necessarily have the same manager or application office. Let us check with the responsible staff using the name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。空いている日を聞く前に、この施設の申込み先か確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 空き状況より先に正しい申込み先を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Before asking which dates are available, I want to check whether this is the application office for that facility.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the correct application office before checking availability. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用目的や人数は、お決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you decided on the purpose of use and the number of people?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 近所の四人で読書会をしたいです。販売や食事は予定していませんが、使えるかは管理者に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 四人の読書会で販売や食事はないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Four of us from the neighborhood want to hold a reading group. We are not planning sales or a meal, but I will ask the manager whether we can use it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that it is a reading group for four people, with no sales or meal. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 場所を間違えないよう、案内先へ施設名もお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also tell the office we refer you to the facility's name so there is no confusion about the location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 地区名付きの名称を読み上げます。前の電話の返答を、この集会所の利用許可とは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 正式名を伝え前の電話を利用許可と扱わないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will read out the name including the district. I will not regard the answer from the previous phone call as permission to use this meeting hall.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the official name and say you will not treat the previous phone call as permission to use it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 名称を確認してご案内します。それでは、担当へお問い合わせください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will confirm the name and direct you accordingly. Please contact the responsible staff. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約票のお名前をご確認いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you check the name on the appointment slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません、私の名前ではありません。家に並べて置いてあった、同居人の予約票を持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同居人の予約票を誤って持参したと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sorry, that is not my name. I brought my housemate's appointment slip, which was lying beside mine at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you mistakenly brought your housemate's appointment slip. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その方の予約として受付はできません。ご自身の予約を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot register you under that person's appointment. Let us check your own appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私も予約してありますが、同じ時間かは覚えていません。間違った紙の時間で来てしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人も予約したが時間は不明で別人の時間に来たと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I also have an appointment, but I do not remember whether it is at the same time. I came at the time on the wrong slip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you also booked, but do not know the time and came at someone else's appointment time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の確認をして、ご自身の予約状況をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will verify your identity and tell you the status of your own appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。同居人の名前を私の名前に書き換えず、この紙はそのまま持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別人の票を改名せずそのまま持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I will take this slip home as it is, without replacing my housemate's name with mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will take the other person's slip home unchanged, without changing the name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身の案内が確認できたら、日時と受診先を見直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you have confirmed your own appointment information, check the date, time, and where you are to be seen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。受診先まで同じとは限らないので、時間だけでなく診療科も確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の日時だけでなく診療科も確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. The place I am to be seen may be different too, so I will check the department as well as the time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check your own date and time and the medical department. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 本日の対応は、ご予約の確認後にご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please discuss what can be done today after your appointment has been checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日受けられると決めつけず、私の予約を確認します。次から予約票を一人ずつ別の袋に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当日受診を決めつけず今後は予約票を別袋にすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check my appointment without assuming I can be seen today. From now on, I will put each person's appointment slip in a separate bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not assume you can be seen today and will keep appointment slips in separate bags from now on. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: まずご本人の予約を確認いたします。それでは、お名前をこちらで伺います。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: First, we will check your own appointment. I will ask your name over here. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 控えの番号についてご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the number on your receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: なくした財布の控えに番号があります。事件の番号だと思い、家族に盗まれたと伝えてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 控えの番号を事件番号と思い家族へ盗難と話したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is a number on the receipt for my lost wallet. I thought it was a crime case number and told my family the wallet had been stolen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you mistook the number on the receipt for a crime case number and told your family it was theft. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 番号だけで盗難が認定されたとは言えません。どの届出の控えか確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: A number alone does not mean theft has been established. Let us check which kind of report this receipt is for.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: なくしたと相談して受け取った紙です。盗られるところを見たわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 遺失の相談で受け取り盗難の目撃はないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is the paper I received when I asked about losing it. I did not actually see it being stolen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you received it when reporting a loss and did not witness theft. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: なくした状況と、新たに分かったことがあれば伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell us how you lost it and anything new you have learned.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 買い物先にも尋ねましたが、まだ見つかっていません。そのことと盗難の判断は別だと分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 店で未発見という事実と盗難判断は別と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I also asked at the shops I visited, but it has not been found yet. I understand that this fact is separate from determining whether it was stolen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that not finding it at the shop is a separate matter from determining theft. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 照会の際は、この控えをもとにご用件をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: When making an inquiry, explain your business using this receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 「財布の遺失物の確認です」と話します。家族にも、番号があるだけで事件とは言えないと訂正します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 遺失物照会と呼び家族へ番号の誤解を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will say, ‘I am checking about a lost wallet.’ I will also correct what I told my family: a number alone does not mean it is a crime case.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Call it a lost-property inquiry and correct your family's misunderstanding about the number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今後、新しい事情が分かったら、その内容をお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you learn any new circumstances, please let us know what they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。紙の名称を読み、確認できた内容だけ伝えます。財布が戻ったら、その連絡方法も聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紙の名称を確認し発見後の連絡方法も尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will read the document's title and only pass on what has been confirmed. I will also ask how to notify you if my wallet is returned.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the document's title and ask how to notify them after it is found. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 控えをご確認いただきありがとうございます。それでは、照会を進めます。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking the receipt. We will now proceed with the inquiry. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切手について、どのようなご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to do regarding stamps?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 旅行の記念に消印を集めたいです。家から、前に手紙から剥がした切手も持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旅行記念に消印を集めたいと使用済切手を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to collect postmarks as souvenirs of my trip. I also brought some stamps I previously peeled off letters at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the used stamps and say you want to collect postmarks as travel souvenirs. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 使用済みの切手を、今回の郵便料金としては使えません。今日は発送もされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Used stamps cannot pay the postage for a new mailing. Will you also be sending anything today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日は送りません。記念に残す押印について聞きたくて、発送の列と同じだと思って並びました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発送せず記念押印を相談したいと明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am not sending anything today. I wanted to ask about souvenir postmarks, and I joined this queue because I thought it was the same as the mailing queue.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Make clear that you are not mailing anything and want to ask about souvenir postmarks. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記念の押印については、取扱いと相談先を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check how souvenir postmarking is handled and whom you should ask.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。持ってきた切手でできるとは決めず、必要な準備を聞いてからにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持参切手で可能と決めず必要な準備を聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I will not assume the stamps I brought can be used; I will first ask what I need to prepare.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will ask what to prepare without assuming the stamps you brought are suitable. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どのような形で残したいか、お決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you decided how you would like to keep them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 小さな台紙にまとめたいです。ただ、押す場所や対象を知らないので、先に貼り付けず持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 台紙に残したいが条件不明なので未貼付と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to arrange them on a small backing card. But I do not know where the postmark can be applied or what qualifies, so I have kept them unattached.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you want them on a backing card but have not attached them because you do not know the conditions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当の案内で、利用できるものや準備方法を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please follow the staff's guidance to check what you can use and how to prepare it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。郵便料金の支払いと記念の相談を分けます。古い切手は見本として見せ、使えるとは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 郵便料金と記念相談を分け古切手は見本と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will keep paying postage separate from asking about souvenirs. I will show the old stamps as examples, without saying they can be used.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate postage payment from the souvenir inquiry and say the old stamps are examples. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を担当へお伝えします。それでは、こちらで確認をお待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will tell the responsible staff what you want. Please wait here while we check. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ATMの画面で、お困りのことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the ATM screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 残高を見たかったのに、振込先を入れる画面になりました。口座番号を入れると残高が出ると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 残高確認のつもりで振込先入力画面に来たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wanted to check my balance, but I reached the screen for entering a transfer recipient. I thought entering an account number would show my balance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you intended to check your balance but reached the transfer-recipient entry screen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 振込の操作と残高の確認は別です。今、送金を実行しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Making a transfer and checking your balance are separate operations. Have you executed a transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、実行する前です。知らない欄なので、適当な番号は入れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未実行で適当な口座番号も入れていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I have not executed it yet. I did not recognize the fields, so I have not entered a random number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not executed the transfer or entered an arbitrary account number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一度操作を中止して、残高確認の案内をご確認ください。暗証番号はこちらへ言わないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Cancel this operation and check the instructions for checking your balance. Do not tell us your PIN.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 番号は話しません。カードが戻るところまで確認してから、初めの画面に戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 暗証番号を口にせず中止後カード返却を確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not say the number. I want to make sure my card has been returned before going back to the initial screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not say your PIN aloud and want to confirm the card is returned after cancellation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: カードや明細をお忘れにならないよう、ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please make sure you do not leave your card or receipt behind.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: カードは戻りました。今回は残高だけ知りたくて、誰にも振り込む予定はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: カード返却済みで送金予定はないと明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: My card has been returned. This time I only want to know my balance and have no plans to transfer money to anyone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make clear that your card has been returned and you do not intend to transfer money. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それでは、残高確認の操作をご案内します。表示内容を周囲へ見せないようになさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then I will explain how to check your balance. Please keep others from seeing what is displayed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認したら画面を終えます。残高を見る操作と送金する操作を、最初の選択から区別します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示を終了し残高確認と送金の選択を分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will close the screen after checking. I will distinguish checking my balance from transferring money from the very first selection.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will close the display and distinguish the balance inquiry and transfer choices. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご用件を確認できました。それでは、案内に沿ってご利用ください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed what you need. Please follow the instructions to use the ATM. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの券についてのご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the voucher you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この買物券は期限内なので、ここで使えると思って来ました。レジの前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 期限内の買物券が店舗で使えるか会計前に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: This shopping voucher is still valid, so I came thinking I could use it here. I would like to check before going to the register.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask before checkout whether a shopping voucher within its validity period can be used at this store. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発行元と対象店舗の記載を確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please let me check the issuer and the participating-store information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 裏にお店の一覧があります。日付だけ見て、一覧までは読んでいませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日付しか見ず裏の対象店一覧を読まなかったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is a list of shops on the back. I only looked at the date and did not read the list.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you only checked the date and did not read the participating-store list on the back. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この券の対象店舗に、当店の名前は記載されていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Our store is not named among the participating stores for this voucher.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうでしたか。今日は別の方法で払います。券を使うつもりで量を増やしたので、買う物を見直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別の支払方法へ変え購入量も見直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I see. I will pay another way today. I increased the amount I chose because I intended to use the voucher, so I would like to reconsider what I am buying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will use another payment method and want to reconsider the quantity you are buying. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まだお会計前ですので、必要な物をお選びください。戻す物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You have not checked out yet, so please choose what you need. Is there anything you want to put back?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 乾麺を一袋戻して、夕食に使う分だけ買います。置き場所が分かる物ですが、渡したほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 乾麺一袋を戻し店員へ渡す方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will return one bag of dried noodles and buy only what I need for dinner. I know where it goes, but should I hand it to you instead?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will return one bag of dried noodles and ask how to hand it to the staff. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらでお預かりします。券は対象店舗での条件をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will take it here. Please check the conditions at the stores that accept the voucher.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。期限と使える店を両方見ます。今日は選び直した品だけ、現金で払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 期限と対象店を確認し今回は現金で必要品だけ買うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will check both the expiry date and the eligible stores. Today I will pay cash only for the items I have chosen again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the expiry date and eligible stores and buy only the necessary items with cash today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 戻す商品はお預かりしました。それでは、お選びの品をレジへどうぞ。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have taken the item you are returning. Please bring your chosen items to the register. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お弁当の場所について、お困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the place where you are eating your lunch?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 食べ物へ蟻が集まっています。家から虫用の薬を持っているので、ここで撒いてもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 弁当に蟻が集まり持参薬を撒けるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Ants are gathering on the food. I have some insecticide I brought from home; may I spread it here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that ants are gathering on your packed lunch and ask whether you can spread the insecticide you brought. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 公園内へご自身の薬を撒かず、まず食べ物を片付けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do not spread your own insecticide in the park. Please put the food away first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。まだ撒いていません。甘い飲み物も倒したので、そちらへ集まっているかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未散布で甘い飲物もこぼしたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I have not spread it yet. I also knocked over a sweet drink, so they may be gathering there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not applied the insecticide and also spilled a sweet drink. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こぼした場所も管理担当へ知らせます。容器やごみは回収できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the maintenance staff where the spill is too. Can you collect the containers and rubbish?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。容器と包みは袋へ入れます。食べ物を地面へ払って、蟻から離すことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 容器と包みを回収し食品を地面へ払わないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will put the containers and wrappers in a bag. I will not brush the food onto the ground to separate it from the ants.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will collect the containers and wrappers and will not brush food onto the ground. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 食べ物の状態が気になる場合は、無理に食べず、ご自身で扱いをご判断ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you are concerned about the condition of the food, do not force yourself to eat it; decide for yourself how to handle it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日はこの弁当を食べ続けず、片付けます。場所だけ変えて薬を撒けばよいとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 弁当を片付け移動先でも薬を撒かないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will put this lunch away instead of continuing to eat it today. I do not think simply moving somewhere else would make it acceptable to spread insecticide.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will put the lunch away and will not spread insecticide at another location either. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 飲み物のこぼれた位置をご案内いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Could you show us where the drink spilled?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: このシートの横です。自分でごみを持ち、液体が広がった所は担当へ示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: こぼれた位置を示しごみを自分で持つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Beside this picnic sheet. I will carry my rubbish myself and show the staff where the liquid has spread.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show where the spill is and say that you will carry your own rubbish. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 位置を確認します。それでは、薬を使わずお片付けをお願いします。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check the location. Please clean up without using insecticide. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: スタンプの写り方について、ご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about how the stamp impression came out?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ノートに押したら、ほとんど写りませんでした。自分のスタンプ用インクを足してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 薄い記念スタンプへ持参インクを足せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I stamped my notebook, it barely showed up. May I add some of my own stamp ink?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may add your own ink to the faint souvenir stamp. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 持参されたインクは使わず、係員に状態をお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do not use the ink you brought. Please tell a staff member about the condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ足していません。このページが薄く写った部分です。強く何度も押すだけでも直らなさそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未補充の薄いページを示し連続して強く押さないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not added any yet. This is the part of the page where the impression is faint. It does not seem that simply pressing hard over and over will fix it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the faint page, say you have not added ink, and say you will not press hard repeatedly. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで確認します。スタンプ本体は今、台に戻してありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check it. Have you put the stamp itself back on its stand?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。傾けたり蓋を開けたりはせず、元の台へ置きました。ノートだけ持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本体を開けず台へ戻しノートだけ持つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I put it back on its original stand without tilting it or opening the lid. I am only holding my notebook.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you returned the stamp to its stand without opening it and are holding only your notebook. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認後、利用できるかご案内します。次の列車までお時間はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: After checking, we will tell you whether you can use it. Do you have time before your next train?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もうすぐ出ます。押し直しのために乗り遅れないよう、確認に時間がかかるなら今日はこのままにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発車が近く確認に時間がかかれば押直しをやめると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: It leaves soon. If checking will take time, I will leave it as it is today so I do not miss my train trying to stamp it again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that departure is close and you will give up restamping if the check takes time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご出発を優先なさってください。薄い記録もそのまま残せますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please prioritize your departure. You can keep the faint impression as it is too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、旅の記録として残します。インクはしまい、出発の表示を見に行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 薄い記録を残しインクをしまって発車表示を見ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I will keep it as a record of my trip. I will put my ink away and go look at the departure display.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep the faint impression, put the ink away, and check the departure display. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 状態を知らせていただきありがとうございます。それでは、お気をつけてご旅行ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for telling us about the condition. Have a safe trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地域活動の紹介について、お尋ねになりたいことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about introducing your community activities?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 活動の話を広報に載せたいと連絡をもらいました。以前ここで相談したので、その時の話も全部載るのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 過去の窓口相談も広報の記事に含まれるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was contacted about featuring our activities in the community newsletter. I consulted here before; will everything I discussed then also be included?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a past consultation at the service counter will be included in the newsletter article. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 窓口の相談と記事の取材は別です。掲載の希望や確認したい点を担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Counter consultations and interviews for articles are separate. Please tell the person responsible your wishes about publication and anything you want to confirm.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 活動の紹介には協力したいです。でも、家族の事情を話した相談内容まで紹介したいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 活動紹介に協力したいが家族相談まで公開したくないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to help introduce our activities. But that does not mean I want the consultation in which I discussed my family circumstances included too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you want to cooperate with the activity feature but do not want the family consultation made public. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記事にする範囲や、お名前の扱いを担当と確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can confirm with the person responsible what the article will cover and how your name will be handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。窓口に書いた名前をそのまま公開してよいとは伝えていません。記事で使う名前も別に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 記録用氏名と記事で使う名前の扱いを別に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I have not said that the name I wrote at the counter may be published as it is. I would also like to discuss separately what name to use in the article.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm separately how the name in the records and the name used in the article will be handled. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真についても、ご希望や懸念をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also tell them your wishes and concerns about photographs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 活動中の写真には友達も写っています。私が協力すると言っても、友達の掲載まで決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真の友人について本人に代わり掲載を決められないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friends are in the photos of our activities too. Even if I agree to cooperate, I cannot decide whether their pictures may be published.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you cannot decide on publication on behalf of the friends in the photographs. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 取材担当へ、範囲を確認してから返事をしたいとお伝えしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us tell the interviewer that you would like to confirm the scope before responding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうしてください。活動、名前、写真を分けて確認し、窓口相談の内容は取材へ自分で混ぜないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 活動と名前と写真の範囲を確かめて取材へ返答すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will check the activities, name, and photos separately and avoid bringing the counter consultation into the interview myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will confirm the scope of activities, names, and photos before responding to the interview request. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認の点を担当へ伝えます。それでは、取材のご案内をお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass your questions to the responsible staff. Please wait for the interview information. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お帰りの前に、お荷物で確認したいことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before you leave, is there anything you would like to check about your belongings?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お借りした毛布を、かばんに入れてしまいました。自分の上着と一緒にまとめたので、持参した物だと思い込んでいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 借りた毛布を私物と一緒に袋へ入れたと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put the blanket I borrowed into my bag. I bundled it with my jacket, so I assumed it was something I had brought.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you put the borrowed blanket in your bag together with your personal belongings. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お知らせありがとうございます。どこでお使いになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you for telling us. Where did you use it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 処置室で待っている時です。帰りの準備で丸めましたが、まだ病院の外へは出ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 処置室で使いまだ院外へ出ていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: While waiting in the treatment room. I rolled it up when getting ready to go home, but I have not left the hospital yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you used it in the treatment room and have not left the hospital yet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使用した物なので、ご自身で棚へ戻さず、職員にお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Since it has been used, please hand it to a staff member instead of putting it back on the shelf yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。空いていた棚に置こうと思いましたが、未使用の物と混ぜないようお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未使用品の棚へ戻さず職員へ渡すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I was going to put it on an empty shelf, but I will hand it over so it does not get mixed with unused items.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will hand it to staff instead of returning it to the shelf for unused items. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: かばんの中に、ほかの借用品はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are there any other borrowed items in your bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ほかにはありません。私の上着とノートだけ残し、毛布を分けて見直しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他の借用品はなく上着とノートから毛布を分けたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, there are no others. I separated out the blanket and checked again, leaving only my jacket and notebook.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that there are no other borrowed items and that you separated the blanket from your jacket and notebook. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらでお預かりします。ご自身のお荷物をもう一度ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will take it here. Please check your own belongings once more.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。お借りした毛布は返しました。私物だけを持って帰ります。気づけてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返却を確認し自分の荷物だけ持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I have returned the borrowed blanket. I will take only my own belongings home. I am glad I noticed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the return and say you will take only your own belongings home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お返しいただきありがとうございます。それでは、お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for returning it. Please take care of yourself.
